questions.questionContent: What are the different lexical issues in Java?
options: Syntax errors, logical errors, and runtime errors
Identifiers, keywords, literals, operators, and separators
Memory leaks, garbage collection, and stack overflow
questions.correctAnswer: Identifiers, keywords, literals, operators, and separators

questions.questionContent: What is an array in Java?
options: A collection of similar data types
A method to store multiple values in a single variable
A data structure that stores elements in a sequential manner

questions.questionContent: What does the '<<' operator do in Java?
What are the object-oriented principles in Java?
What is a constructor in Java?
options: A method used to initialize objects
A special method with the same name as the class

questions.questionContent: What is recursion in Java?
options: A process where a method calls itself
A method that calls another method
questions.correctAnswer: A process where a method calls itself

questions.questionContent: What are the access specifiers in Java?
What is call by value in Java?
options: Passing a copy of the variable to a method
Passing the reference of the variable to a method
questions.correctAnswer: Passing a copy of the variable to a method

questions.questionContent: What is multilevel inheritance in Java?
options: A class inherits from a derived class
A class inherits from multiple classes
A class inherits from a single base class
questions.correctAnswer: A class inherits from a derived class

questions.questionContent: What is an interface in Java?
options: A way to achieve multiple inheritance

questions.questionContent: What is method overriding in Java?
options: Providing a specific implementation of a method in a subclass
Creating a new method with the same name in the same class
questions.correctAnswer: Providing a specific implementation of a method in a subclass

questions.questionContent: What is a package in Java?
options: A group of related classes and interfaces

questions.questionContent: What is an exception in Java?
options: An event that disrupts the normal flow of the program
A syntax error in the code
A logical error in the code
questions.correctAnswer: An event that disrupts the normal flow of the program

questions.questionContent: What is a thread in Java?
options: A way to execute multiple tasks simultaneously

questions.questionContent: What is synchronization in Java?
options: A way to control access to shared resources
A method to create multiple threads
questions.correctAnswer: A way to control access to shared resources

questions.questionContent: What is multithreading in Java?
options: Executing a single thread at a time

questions.questionContent: What is auto-boxing in Java?
options: Automatic conversion of primitive types to their wrapper classes
Automatic conversion of wrapper classes to primitive types
questions.correctAnswer: Automatic conversion of primitive types to their wrapper classes

questions.questionContent: What is the 'super' keyword used for in Java?
options: To refer to the immediate parent class object
To call the parent class constructor

questions.questionContent: What is an abstract class in Java?
options: A class that cannot be instantiated
A class that contains abstract methods

questions.questionContent: What is the purpose of the 'this' keyword in Java?
options: To refer to the current object
To call another constructor in the same class
